primitives.name: Additive Schema Migration
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Prisma Safety Lab - GSE Wave 2 ## Grounding Diagnostic (via GitHub API 2026-07-22) - Repo: Beexly/Sports main - packages/db/prisma/ : schema.prisma (84k), seed.ts (62k with idempotent upserts, env=prod guards, count checks), 20+ migrations (additive only).
primitives.assumptions: Migrations must be strictly additive to preserve backward compatibility.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when non-additive changes are introduced without proper shadow validation.

layer2.mapping: Each migration corresponds to an isomorphic transformation in the relational algebra of database schemas.
layer2.telemetry: Migration count and schema size growth rate

primitives.name: Dual Write Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Safe Patterns - **Expand/Contract**: Add columns (nullable), dual-write, backfill, @ignore old, contract.
primitives.assumptions: New fields are written to both old and new schema locations until full rollout.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Data inconsistency arises if writes fail to propagate to both systems.

layer2.mapping: Kernel operation models concurrent writes across schema versions using temporal logic.
layer2.telemetry: Write latency difference between old and new schema targets

primitives.name: Optimistic Locking
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Shadow: Use `prisma db push --schema=./prisma/shadow.prisma` or Docker Postgres `postgres:16-test` + `PRISMA_DATABASE_URL=...` - Introspection: `npx prisma db pull --url "postgresql://..." --schema=shadow` - Versioning: Add `version Int @default(1) @updatedAt` or `optimisticLock` field + `where: {id, version}` in updates.
primitives.assumptions: Update conflicts are resolved by comparing version numbers before applying changes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Race condition occurs when two processes attempt to update same record simultaneously.

layer2.mapping: Versioned updates mirror atomic operations in concurrent programming models.
layer2.telemetry: Conflict resolution frequency and average retry count per transaction
